dict.string: Pixie listens while you hold Control-Option so you can talk to it.
Pixie turns what you say into text on this Mac.
Pixie can find and save files on your Desktop when you ask.
Pixie can find and save files in Documents when you ask.
Pixie can find and save files in Downloads when you ask.
Pixie uses an app's own scripting to do things you ask for.
